segments.src: ## A Financial Lifeline Sought Amid Conflict
segments.tr: ## 금융 생명선 찾기

segments.src: Even as fighting with the United States and Israel remains unresolved and sanctions continue to squeeze its economy, Iran is pushing hard on a different front: banking diplomacy.
segments.tr: 미국과 이스라엘과의 전쟁이 해결되지 않고 제재가 계속 경제를 압박하는 가운데 이란은 다른 전선에서 열심히 노력하고 있다: 은행 외교.

segments.src: Officials at Iran's central bank have said in recent statements that the country's long-pursued membership in the BRICS New Development Bank (NDB) is nearing completion — a move that, if finalized, would give Tehran access to project financing and payment channels that operate outside the U.S.
segments.tr: 이란 중앙은행의 관리들은 최근의 성명에서 이란이 오랫동안 추구해온 브릭스 신개발은행(NDB) 회원국 가입이 완료되려면 — 이란이 미국 달러 시스템 외부에서 프로젝트 자금 조달과 결제 채널에 접근할 수 있게 해주는 조치 — 거의 완료 단계에 이르렀다고 말했다.

segments.src: dollar system.
segments.tr: 달러 시스템.

segments.src: The timing is notable.
segments.tr: 타이밍은 주목할 만하다.

segments.src: Most countries pursue multilateral financial memberships during periods of relative stability, when technical and legal groundwork can proceed without geopolitical noise.
segments.tr: 대부분의 국가들은 기술적 및 법적 기초 작업을 지연시키지 않고 진행할 수 있는 상대적 안정기의 다자간 금융 회원국을 추구한다.

segments.src: Iran is instead advancing this bid in the middle of active hostilities, which underscores just how central "de-dollarization" has become to its economic survival strategy.
segments.tr: 이란은 대신 활발한 전투 중에 이 입찰을 진행하고 있는데, 이는 "탈달러화"가 이란의 경제 생존 전략의 핵심이 되고 있음을 강조한다.

segments.src: ## What the New Development Bank Actually Is
segments.tr: ## 신개발은행이 실제로 무엇인지

segments.src: Founded in 2015 by Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — the original BRICS members — the New Development Bank was designed as an alternative to Western-led institutions like the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 브라질, 러시아, 인도, 중국, 남아프리카 — 원래 브릭스 회원국 — 에 의해 2015년에 설립된 신개발은행은 세계은행이나 국제 통화 기금과 같은 서방 주도 기관의 대안으로 설계되었다.

segments.src: It funds infrastructure and sustainable development projects, and increasingly issues loans in local currencies rather than U.S.
segments.tr: 인프라와 지속 가능한 개발 프로젝트를 자금 지원하며, 점점 더 미국 달러가 아닌 현지 통화로 대출을 발급하는 특징이 있어 달러 기반의 제재에 노출되는 것을 줄이고 싶어하는 국가들에게 매력적으로 느껴진다.

segments.src: dollars, a feature that has made it attractive to countries seeking to reduce their exposure to dollar-based sanctions.
segments.tr: 달러, 이 특징은 달러 기반 제재에 노출되는 것을 줄이고 싶어하는 국가들에게 매력적으로 느껴진다.

segments.src: Iran formally joined the broader BRICS group as a full member in January 2024, alongside Egypt, Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates.
segments.tr: 이란은 2024년 1월 이집트, 에티오피아, 아랍에미리트와 함께 브릭스 그룹에 정회원으로 공식적으로 가입했다.

segments.src: Membership in BRICS itself, however, is separate from membership in the NDB, which has its own governance process, capital contribution requirements and voting structure.
segments.tr: 그러나 브릭스 자체의 회원국 가입은 자체 거버넌스 프로세스, 자본 기여 요구 사항 및 투표 구조가 있는 NDB 회원국 가입과는 별개이다.

segments.src: Iranian officials have periodically signaled progress on this second, more technical step, framing it as a natural extension of BRICS accession rather than a new initiative.
segments.tr: 이란 관리들은 이 두 번째, 더 기술적인 단계에서 진도를 보인 것으로 정기적으로 신호를 보냈으며, 이를 브릭스 가입의 자연스러운 확장으로 프레임링했으며, 새로운 이니셔티브는 아니다.

segments.src: ## Why a Bank Matters More Than a Bloc
segments.tr: ## 은행이 블록보다 더 중요하다

segments.src: For a country under some of the most extensive sanctions regimes in the world, symbolic bloc membership only goes so far.
segments.tr: 세계에서 가장 광범위한 제재 체제 중 하나에 처한 국가에게 상징적인 블록 회원국은 한계가 있다.

segments.src: What Iran needs, according to economists who track sanctioned economies, is actual liquidity: financing for infrastructure, energy and trade projects that Western-aligned banks and institutions are barred — or unwilling — to provide.
segments.tr: 이란이 필요한 것은, 제재된 경제를 추적하는 경제학자에 따르면, 실제 유동성이다: 서방과 제휴된 은행이나 기관이 제공하지 않거나 제공하기를 꺼리는 인프라, 에너지, 무역 프로젝트 자금 조달.

segments.src: NDB membership would theoretically open a channel for exactly that.
segments.tr: NDB 회원국 가입은 이론적으로 정확히 그것을 위한 채널을 열어줄 것이다.

segments.src: It would also allow Iran to settle at least some transactions with fellow member states in currencies other than the dollar, reducing the risk that payments get frozen or blocked as they pass through the dollar-clearing system, where U.S.
segments.tr: 또한 미국 달러 외의 통화로 회원국 간에 少なくとも 일부 거래를 해결할 수 있게 해주며, 미국

segments.src: regulators have significant oversight.
segments.tr: 규제당국이 상당한 감독을 行使하는 달러 결제 시스템을 통해 통과하는 동안 결제가 동결되거나 차단되는 위험을 줄여준다.

segments.src: Analysts caution, however, that the practical impact should not be overstated.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 그러나 실제적인 영향력이 과장되지 않도록 주의해야 한다고 경고한다.

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: NDB의 총 대출 능력은 세계은행의 그것의 한 조각에 불과하며, 은행 자체는 국제 시장에서 자본을 조달해야 하므로 서방 투자자가 중요한 곳에서 얼마나密接하게 제재된 회원국과 연관시키고 싶은지权衡해야 한다.

segments.src: Russia's experience — a founding NDB member that has faced difficulty accessing the bank's own resources since 2022 due to compliance concerns among other shareholders — is often cited as a cautionary example.
segments.tr: 2022년 이후 다른 주주들 사이에서 준수 문제로 인해 은행의 자원에 접근하기가 어려웠던 NDB의 창립 회원국인 러시아의 경험은 종종 경고의 예로 인용된다.

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## 더 넓은 패턴, 고립된 사례가 아님

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: 이란의 추진은 전통적인 서방 감독 외부에 위치한 금융 인프라를 구축하는 제재된 또는 제재에 민감한 경제들 사이에서 더 넓은 추세에 들어맞는다.

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: 러시아, 중국, 그리고 몇몇 걸프 국가들은 모두 최근 몇 년 동안 다양한 방식으로 현지 통화 거래 협정, 대안 결제 메시징 시스템, 비달러 준비 보유액을 확대했다.

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: 이것이 실제로 달러 지배에서 구조적인 전환을 의미하는지, 또는 제재된 국가의 작은 수의 작업 아라운드인지 여부는 경제학자 사이에서 논쟁의 주제이다.

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: 달러는 여전히 세계 무역 송장의 대부분과 중앙은행 준비금을 차지하며, NDB와 같은 기관은 비교하면 작다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주목할 점

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: 향후 주요 마커는 극적인 것보다는 절차적인 것: 이란의 NDB 가입이 은행 이사회에 의해 공식적으로 비준되는지, 할당된 자본 기여와 투표 점유율은 무엇인지, 그리고 은행이 이란의 이니셔티브에 대한 프로젝트 자금 조달을 승인하기 위해 얼마나 빠르게 움직이는지.

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: 은행의 기존 제재된 회원국에 대한 주의로운 태도에 비추어 볼 때, 대부분의 관찰자는 이란에 대한 구체적인 금융 이익이 공식적인 회원국 가입 후에도 점진적인 것보다는 즉각적인 것이라고 예상한다.

segments.src: For now, the story is less about an imminent alternative to the dollar and more about how sanctioned states are quietly building the scaffolding for one, one institutional membership at a time.
segments.tr: 현재의 이야기에서는 임박한 달러 대안에 관한 것이 아니라 제재된 국가들이 조용히 하나의 기관 회원국마다 대안을 구축하고 있다는 것이다.

zh.title: 用银行代替美元：为什么伊朗在战时争相加入金砖国家开发银行

segments.src: ## A Financial Lifeline Sought Amid Conflict
segments.tr: ## 冲突中寻求的金融生命线

segments.src: Even as fighting with the United States and Israel remains unresolved and sanctions continue to squeeze its economy, Iran is pushing hard on a different front: banking diplomacy.
segments.tr: 尽管与美国和以色列的冲突仍在持续，且制裁继续挤压其经济，但伊朗正在另一个战线上全力推进：银行外交。

segments.src: Officials at Iran's central bank have said in recent statements that the country's long-pursued membership in the BRICS New Development Bank (NDB) is nearing completion — a move that, if finalized, would give Tehran access to project financing and payment channels that operate outside the U.S.
segments.tr: 伊朗中央银行官员在最近的声明中表示，该国长期追求的加入金砖国家新开发银行（NDB）的事宜已接近完成——这一举动如果最终敲定，将使德黑兰获得在美伊之外运行的项目融资和支付渠道。

segments.src: dollar system.
segments.tr: 美元体系。

segments.src: The timing is notable.
segments.tr: 这一时机引人注目。

segments.src: Most countries pursue multilateral financial memberships during periods of relative stability, when technical and legal groundwork can proceed without geopolitical noise.
segments.tr: 大多数国家在相对稳定的时期寻求多边金融成员身份，此时技术和法律基础工作可以在没有地缘政治噪音的情况下进行。

segments.src: Iran is instead advancing this bid in the middle of active hostilities, which underscores just how central "de-dollarization" has become to its economic survival strategy.
segments.tr: 然而，伊朗却在激烈的敌对行动中推进这一投标，这凸显了“去美元化”对其经济生存战略变得多么核心。

segments.src: ## What the New Development Bank Actually Is
segments.tr: ## 新开发银行到底是什么

segments.src: Founded in 2015 by Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — the original BRICS members — the New Development Bank was designed as an alternative to Western-led institutions like the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: 新开发银行由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非这五个最初的金砖国家成员于2015年创立，旨在作为世界银行和国际货币基金组织等西方主导机构的替代方案。

segments.src: It funds infrastructure and sustainable development projects, and increasingly issues loans in local currencies rather than U.S.
segments.tr: 它资助基础设施和可持续发展项目，并且越来越多地以本币而不是美元发放贷款。

segments.src: dollars, a feature that has made it attractive to countries seeking to reduce their exposure to dollar-based sanctions.
segments.tr: 美元，这一特点使其对寻求减少对美元制裁暴露度的国家具有吸引力。

segments.src: Iran formally joined the broader BRICS group as a full member in January 2024, alongside Egypt, Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates.
segments.tr: 2024年1月，伊朗与埃及、埃塞俄比亚和阿拉伯联合酋长国一起，正式加入扩大的金砖国家集团，成为正式成员。

segments.src: Membership in BRICS itself, however, is separate from membership in the NDB, which has its own governance process, capital contribution requirements and voting structure.
segments.tr: 然而，金砖国家本身的成员身份与新开发银行的成员身份是分开的，后者有其自己的治理流程、资本出资要求和投票结构。

segments.src: Iranian officials have periodically signaled progress on this second, more technical step, framing it as a natural extension of BRICS accession rather than a new initiative.
segments.tr: 伊朗官员不定期地表示这一第二步（更具技术性的步骤）取得了进展，并将其视为金砖国家加入的自然延伸，而不是一项新倡议。

segments.src: ## Why a Bank Matters More Than a Bloc
segments.tr: ## 为什么银行比集团更重要

segments.src: For a country under some of the most extensive sanctions regimes in the world, symbolic bloc membership only goes so far.
segments.tr: 对于一个受到世界上最广泛制裁体制之一影响的国家来说，象征性的集团成员身份作用有限。

segments.src: What Iran needs, according to economists who track sanctioned economies, is actual liquidity: financing for infrastructure, energy and trade projects that Western-aligned banks and institutions are barred — or unwilling — to provide.
segments.tr: 跟踪受制裁经济体的经济学家表示，伊朗真正需要的是实际流动性：西方盟友银行和机构被禁止或不愿提供的基础设施、能源和贸易项目融资。

segments.src: NDB membership would theoretically open a channel for exactly that.
segments.tr: 理论上，新开发银行成员身份将为实现这一目标开辟渠道。

segments.src: It would also allow Iran to settle at least some transactions with fellow member states in currencies other than the dollar, reducing the risk that payments get frozen or blocked as they pass through the dollar-clearing system, where U.S.
segments.tr: 这也将允许伊朗用美元以外的货币与成员国结算至少部分交易，从而降低支付在通过美元清算系统时被冻结或阻止的风险，在该系统中，美国

segments.src: regulators have significant oversight.
segments.tr: 监管机构拥有重大监督权。

segments.src: Analysts caution, however, that the practical impact should not be overstated.
segments.tr: 然而，分析人士警告称，其实际影响不应被夸大。

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: 新开发银行的总贷款能力只是世界银行的一小部分，鉴于该行自身需要在西方投资者仍然重要的国际市场上筹集资本，该行本身必须权衡它希望与一个遭受严厉制裁的成员保持多紧密的联系。

segments.src: Russia's experience — a founding NDB member that has faced difficulty accessing the bank's own resources since 2022 due to compliance concerns among other shareholders — is often cited as a cautionary example.
segments.tr: 俄罗斯的经验——作为新开发银行的创始成员国，自2022年以来由于其他股东的合规担忧而一直难以获得该行自身的资源——经常被引为前车之鉴。

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## 更广泛的模式，而非孤立案例

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: 伊朗的这一举动符合受制裁或对制裁保持警惕的经济体建立位于传统西方监管之外的金融基础设施的更广泛趋势。

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: 过去几年，俄罗斯、中国和几个海湾国家都以不同方式扩大了本币贸易协定、替代支付报文系统和非美元外汇储备持有量。

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: 这是否构成了对美元主导地位的真正的结构性转变——还是仅仅是一小部分遭受严厉制裁的国家的变通方案——仍然是经济学家们争论的主题。

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: 美元仍然占全球贸易开票和央行外汇储备的大多数，相比之下，像新开发银行这样的机构仍然很小。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来关注什么

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: 未来的关键标志是程序性的，而不是戏剧性的：伊朗加入新开发银行是否获得该行董事会的正式批准，为其分配了多少资本出资和投票份额，以及该行以多快的速度（如果有的话）批准对伊朗倡议的项目融资。

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: 鉴于该行对现有受制裁成员的谨慎态度，大多数观察家预计，即使在正式确认成员身份之后，伊朗获得的任何切实的财务利益也将是渐进的，而不是立即生效的。

segments.src: Iran formally joined the broader BRICS group as a full member in January 2024, alongside Egypt, Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates.
segments.tr: ईरान ने जनवरी 2024 में मिस्र, इथियोपिया और संयुक्त अरब अमीरात के साथ पूर्ण सदस्य के रूप में व्यापक ब्रिक्स समूह में औपचारिक रूप से प्रवेश किया।

segments.src: Membership in BRICS itself, however, is separate from membership in the NDB, which has its own governance process, capital contribution requirements and voting structure.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, ब्रिक्स की सदस्यता स्वयं NDB की सदस्यता से अलग है, जिसकी अपनी शासन प्रक्रिया, पूंजी योगदान आवश्यकताएं और मतदान संरचना है।

segments.src: Iranian officials have periodically signaled progress on this second, more technical step, framing it as a natural extension of BRICS accession rather than a new initiative.
segments.tr: ईरानी अधिकारियों ने समय-समय पर इस दूसरे, अधिक तकनीकी चरण पर प्रगति का संकेत दिया है, इसे एक नई पहल के बजाय ब्रिक्स परिग्रहण के स्वाभाविक विस्तार के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया है।

segments.src: ## Why a Bank Matters More Than a Bloc
segments.tr: ## एक ब्लॉक से ज्यादा बैंक क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: For a country under some of the most extensive sanctions regimes in the world, symbolic bloc membership only goes so far.
segments.tr: दुनिया में सबसे व्यापक प्रतिबंध व्यवस्थाओं में से एक के तहत रहने वाले देश के लिए, प्रतीकात्मक ब्लॉक सदस्यता केवल एक हद तक ही काम आती है।

segments.src: What Iran needs, according to economists who track sanctioned economies, is actual liquidity: financing for infrastructure, energy and trade projects that Western-aligned banks and institutions are barred — or unwilling — to provide.
segments.tr: प्रतिबंधित अर्थव्यवस्थाओं पर नज़र रखने वाले अर्थशास्त्रियों के अनुसार, ईरान को जिस चीज़ की ज़रूरत है, वह है वास्तविक तरलता: बुनियादी ढांचे, ऊर्जा और व्यापार परियोजनाओं के लिए वित्तपोषण जिसे पश्चिमी-गठबंधन बैंक और संस्थान प्रदान करने से प्रतिबंधित हैं — या अनिच्छुक हैं।

segments.src: NDB membership would theoretically open a channel for exactly that.
segments.tr: NDB सदस्यता सैद्धांतिक रूप से ठीक उसी के लिए एक चैनल खोलेगी।

segments.src: It would also allow Iran to settle at least some transactions with fellow member states in currencies other than the dollar, reducing the risk that payments get frozen or blocked as they pass through the dollar-clearing system, where U.S.
segments.tr: यह ईरान को साथी सदस्य देशों के साथ डॉलर के अलावा अन्य मुद्राओं में कम से कम कुछ लेनदेन निपटाने की अनुमति देगा, जिससे यह जोखिम कम हो जाएगा कि भुगतान डॉलर-समाशोधन प्रणाली से गुजरते समय फ्रीज या अवरुद्ध हो जाएं, जहां अमेरिकी

segments.src: regulators have significant oversight.
segments.tr: नियामकों की महत्वपूर्ण निगरानी होती है।

segments.src: Analysts caution, however, that the practical impact should not be overstated.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, विश्लेषकों ने चेतावनी दी है कि व्यावहारिक प्रभाव को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर नहीं बताया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: NDB की कुल ऋण क्षमता विश्व बैंक की तुलना में बहुत कम है, और बैंक को स्वयं यह तौलना होगा कि वह भारी प्रतिबंधों वाले सदस्य के साथ कितनी निकटता से जुड़ना चाहता है, यह देखते हुए कि उसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजारों में पूंजी जुटाने की अपनी आवश्यकता है जहां पश्चिमी निवेशक महत्वपूर्ण बने हुए हैं।

segments.src: Russia's experience — a founding NDB member that has faced difficulty accessing the bank's own resources since 2022 due to compliance concerns among other shareholders — is often cited as a cautionary example.
segments.tr: रूस का अनुभव — एक संस्थापक NDB सदस्य जिसे 2022 से अन्य शेयरधारकों के बीच अनुपालन संबंधी चिंताओं के कारण बैंक के स्वयं के संसाधनों तक पहुंचने में कठिनाई का सामना करना पड़ा है — अक्सर एक चेतावनी उदाहरण के रूप में उद्धृत किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## एक व्यापक पैटर्न, न कि कोई अलग मामला

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: ईरान का प्रयास प्रतिबंधित या प्रतिबंधों से आशंकित अर्थव्यवस्थाओं के बीच एक व्यापक प्रवृत्ति में फिट बैठता है ताकि ऐसी वित्तीय बुनियादी ढांचा तैयार किया जा सके जो पारंपरिक पश्चिमी निगरानी से बाहर हो।

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: रूस, चीन और कई खाड़ी देशों ने पिछले कई वर्षों में अलग-अलग तरीकों से स्थानीय-मुद्रा व्यापार समझौतों, वैकल्पिक भुगतान संदेश प्रणालियों और गैर-डॉलर आरक्षित होल्डिंग्स का विस्तार किया है।

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: क्या यह डॉलर के प्रभुत्व से दूर एक वास्तविक संरचनात्मक बदलाव है — या केवल भारी प्रतिबंधों वाले कुछ देशों के लिए कामचलाऊ व्यवस्थाओं का एक समूह — यह अर्थशास्त्रियों के बीच बहस का विषय बना हुआ है।

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: डॉलर अभी भी वैश्विक व्यापार इनवॉइसिंग और केंद्रीय बैंक भंडार के बड़े बहुमत के लिए जिम्मेदार है, और NDB जैसी संस्थाएं तुलनात्मक रूप से छोटी बनी हुई हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: आगे बढ़ने के लिए प्रमुख संकेतक नाटकीय के बजाय प्रक्रियात्मक हैं: क्या ईरान के NDB परिग्रहण को बैंक के बोर्ड द्वारा औपचारिक रूप से अनुमोदित किया जाता है, उसे क्या पूंजी योगदान और मतदान हिस्सा सौंपा जाता है, और बैंक ईरानी पहलों के लिए परियोजना वित्तपोषण को मंजूरी देने के लिए कितनी जल्दी — यदि बिल्कुल भी — आगे बढ़ता है।

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: मौजूदा प्रतिबंधित सदस्यों के प्रति बैंक के सतर्क रुख को देखते हुए, अधिकांश पर्यवेक्षकों को उम्मीद है कि ईरान को कोई भी ठोस वित्तीय लाभ औपचारिक सदस्यता की पुष्टि के बाद भी तत्काल के बजाय धीरे-धीरे मिलेगा।

segments.src: For now, the story is less about an imminent alternative to the dollar and more about how sanctioned states are quietly building the scaffolding for one, one institutional membership at a time.
segments.tr: फिलहाल, कहानी डॉलर के आसन्न विकल्प के बारे में कम है और इस बारे में अधिक है कि कैसे प्रतिबंधित राज्य चुपचाप एक-एक संस्थागत सदस्यता के साथ इसके लिए मचान (scaffolding) तैयार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case

segments.src: It would also allow Iran to settle at least some transactions with fellow member states in currencies other than the dollar, reducing the risk that payments get frozen or blocked as they pass through the dollar-clearing system, where U.S.

segments.tr: 規制当局が大きな監視権を持つドル決済システムを経由する際に、支払いが凍結またはブロックされるリスクを軽減できる。

segments.src: Analysts caution, however, that the practical impact should not be overstated.
segments.tr: しかし、アナリストは実質的な影響を過大評価すべきではないと警告している。

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: NDBの総融資能力は世界銀行のほんの一部に過ぎず、銀行自体が国際市場で資金を調達する必要がある中で、西側投資家が依然として重要である以上、重い制裁を受けている加盟国とどれだけ密接に関わりたいかを慎重に検討しなければならないからだ。

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## 孤立したケースではなく、より広範なパターン

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: イランの動きは、制裁を受けている、あるいは制裁を懸念する経済圏が、従来の西側の監視の外にある金融インフラを構築しようとする広範な傾向に合致している。

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: ロシア、中国、そして数カ国の湾岸諸国は、ここ数年でそれぞれ異なる方法で、現地通貨による貿易協定、代替的な決済メッセージングシステム、ドル以外の準備資産の保有を拡大してきた。

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: これがドル支配からの真の構造的転換を意味するのか、それとも単に制裁を受けている少数の国々のための回避策の集合体に過ぎないのかは、経済学者の間で議論の的となっている。

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: ドルは依然として世界の貿易請求や中央銀行の準備資産の大部分を占めており、NDBのような機関は比較すると依然として小規模である。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の注目点

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: 今後の重要な指標は、劇的なものではなく手続き的なものだ。イランのNDB加盟が銀行の理事会によって正式に承認されるか、どのような資本拠出と議決権が割り当てられるか、そして銀行がイランのイニシアチブに対するプロジェクト融資を承認する動きをどれだけ早く見せるか（あるいは全く見せないか）である。

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: 既存の制裁対象メンバーに対する銀行の慎重な姿勢を考えると、正式な加盟が確認された後であっても、イランにとっての具体的な経済的利益は即時ではなく段階的なものになると、ほとんどの観察者は予想している。

segments.src: For now, the story is less about an imminent alternative to the dollar and more about how sanctioned states are quietly building the scaffolding for one, one institutional membership at a time.
segments.tr: 現時点では、この話は差し迫ったドルの代替手段に関するものではなく、制裁対象国がいかにして静かに、一つずつ機関への加盟を重ねながら、そのための足場を築いているかという点に本質がある。

de.title: Eine Bank statt des Dollars: Warum der Iran mitten im Krieg den Beitritt zur BRICS-Entwicklungsbank vorantreibt

segments.src: ## A Financial Lifeline Sought Amid Conflict

segments.src: Even as fighting with the United States and Israel remains unresolved and sanctions continue to squeeze its economy, Iran is pushing hard on a different front: banking diplomacy.
segments.tr: Auch wenn die Kämpfe mit den Vereinigten Staaten und Israel ungelöst bleiben und Sanktionen die Wirtschaft weiterhin belasten, drängt der Iran an einer anderen Front voran: der Bankendiplomatie.

segments.src: Officials at Iran's central bank have said in recent statements that the country's long-pursued membership in the BRICS New Development Bank (NDB) is nearing completion — a move that, if finalized, would give Tehran access to project financing and payment channels that operate outside the U.S.
segments.tr: Beamte der iranischen Zentralbank haben in jüngsten Erklärungen mitgeteilt, dass die seit langem angestrebte Mitgliedschaft des Landes in der New Development Bank (NDB) der BRICS-Staaten kurz vor dem Abschluss steht – ein Schritt, der Teheran, sollte er vollzogen werden, Zugang zu Projektfinanzierungen und Zahlungskanälen verschaffen würde, die außerhalb des US-

segments.src: dollar system.
segments.tr: Dollarsystems operieren.

segments.src: The timing is notable.
segments.tr: Das Timing ist bemerkenswert.

segments.src: Most countries pursue multilateral financial memberships during periods of relative stability, when technical and legal groundwork can proceed without geopolitical noise.
segments.tr: Die meisten Länder streben multilaterale Finanzmitgliedschaften in Zeiten relativer Stabilität an, wenn die technische und rechtliche Grundlage ohne geopolitische Störgeräusche voranschreiten kann.

segments.src: Iran is instead advancing this bid in the middle of active hostilities, which underscores just how central "de-dollarization" has become to its economic survival strategy.
segments.tr: Der Iran treibt dieses Vorhaben stattdessen inmitten aktiver Feindseligkeiten voran, was unterstreicht, wie zentral die „Entdollarisierung“ für seine wirtschaftliche Überlebensstrategie geworden ist.

segments.src: ## What the New Development Bank Actually Is
segments.tr: ## Was die New Development Bank eigentlich ist

segments.src: Founded in 2015 by Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa — the original BRICS members — the New Development Bank was designed as an alternative to Western-led institutions like the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
segments.tr: Die 2015 von Brasilien, Russland, Indien, China und Südafrika – den ursprünglichen BRICS-Mitgliedern – gegründete New Development Bank wurde als Alternative zu westlich geprägten Institutionen wie der Weltbank und dem Internationalen Währungsfonds konzipiert.

segments.src: It funds infrastructure and sustainable development projects, and increasingly issues loans in local currencies rather than U.S.
segments.tr: Sie finanziert Infrastruktur- und nachhaltige Entwicklungsprojekte und vergibt zunehmend Kredite in Lokalwährungen statt in US-

segments.src: dollars, a feature that has made it attractive to countries seeking to reduce their exposure to dollar-based sanctions.
segments.tr: Dollar, eine Eigenschaft, die sie für Länder attraktiv gemacht hat, die ihre Anfälligkeit gegenüber dollarbasierten Sanktionen verringern wollen.

segments.src: Iran formally joined the broader BRICS group as a full member in January 2024, alongside Egypt, Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates.
segments.tr: Der Iran trat im Januar 2024 zusammen mit Ägypten, Äthiopien und den Vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten offiziell als Vollmitglied der erweiterten BRICS-Gruppe bei.

segments.src: Membership in BRICS itself, however, is separate from membership in the NDB, which has its own governance process, capital contribution requirements and voting structure.
segments.tr: Die Mitgliedschaft in den BRICS selbst ist jedoch von der Mitgliedschaft in der NDB getrennt, die über einen eigenen Governance-Prozess, Kapitalbeitragsanforderungen und eine eigene Stimmrechtsstruktur verfügt.

segments.src: Iranian officials have periodically signaled progress on this second, more technical step, framing it as a natural extension of BRICS accession rather than a new initiative.
segments.tr: Iranische Beamte haben regelmäßig Fortschritte bei diesem zweiten, technischeren Schritt signalisiert und ihn eher als natürliche Erweiterung des BRICS-Beitritts denn als neue Initiative dargestellt.

segments.src: ## Why a Bank Matters More Than a Bloc
segments.tr: ## Warum eine Bank wichtiger ist als ein Block

segments.src: For a country under some of the most extensive sanctions regimes in the world, symbolic bloc membership only goes so far.
segments.tr: Für ein Land, das unter einigen der umfassendsten Sanktionsregime der Welt steht, bringt eine symbolische Blockmitgliedschaft nur begrenzt etwas.

segments.src: What Iran needs, according to economists who track sanctioned economies, is actual liquidity: financing for infrastructure, energy and trade projects that Western-aligned banks and institutions are barred — or unwilling — to provide.
segments.tr: Was der Iran laut Ökonomen, die sanktionierte Volkswirtschaften beobachten, benötigt, ist tatsächliche Liquidität: Finanzierungen für Infrastruktur-, Energie- und Handelsprojekte, die westlich orientierte Banken und Institutionen nicht bereitstellen dürfen – oder wollen.

segments.src: NDB membership would theoretically open a channel for exactly that.
segments.tr: Eine NDB-Mitgliedschaft würde theoretisch genau dafür einen Kanal öffnen.

segments.src: It would also allow Iran to settle at least some transactions with fellow member states in currencies other than the dollar, reducing the risk that payments get frozen or blocked as they pass through the dollar-clearing system, where U.S.

segments.tr: Regulierungsbehörden eine erhebliche Aufsicht ausüben.

segments.src: Analysts caution, however, that the practical impact should not be overstated.
segments.tr: Analysten warnen jedoch davor, die praktischen Auswirkungen zu überschätzen.

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: Die gesamte Kreditvergabekapazität der NDB ist nur ein Bruchteil derjenigen der Weltbank, und die Bank selbst muss abwägen, wie eng sie mit einem stark sanktionierten Mitglied verbunden sein möchte, angesichts ihrer eigenen Notwendigkeit, Kapital auf internationalen Märkten zu beschaffen, auf denen westliche Investoren weiterhin wichtig sind.

segments.src: Russia's experience — a founding NDB member that has faced difficulty accessing the bank's own resources since 2022 due to compliance concerns among other shareholders — is often cited as a cautionary example.
segments.tr: Die Erfahrung Russlands – ein Gründungsmitglied der NDB, das seit 2022 aufgrund von Compliance-Bedenken anderer Anteilseigner Schwierigkeiten beim Zugang zu den eigenen Ressourcen der Bank hat – wird oft als warnendes Beispiel angeführt.

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## Ein breiteres Muster, kein Einzelfall

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: Der Vorstoß des Iran fügt sich in einen breiteren Trend unter sanktionierten oder sanktionsbewussten Volkswirtschaften ein, Finanzinfrastrukturen aufzubauen, die außerhalb der traditionellen westlichen Aufsicht liegen.

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: Russland, China und mehrere Golfstaaten haben in den letzten Jahren auf unterschiedliche Weise Handelsabkommen in Lokalwährungen, alternative Zahlungsnachrichtensysteme und Nicht-Dollar-Reserven ausgeweitet.

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: Ob dies einem echten strukturellen Wandel weg von der Dominanz des Dollars gleichkommt – oder lediglich eine Reihe von Umgehungslösungen für eine kleine Anzahl stark sanktionierter Staaten darstellt – bleibt unter Ökonomen umstritten.

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: Der Dollar macht immer noch den Großteil der weltweiten Handelsfakturierung und der Zentralbankreserven aus, und Institutionen wie die NDB bleiben im Vergleich dazu klein.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes zu beobachten ist

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: Die entscheidenden Indikatoren für die Zukunft sind eher verfahrenstechnischer als dramatischer Natur: ob der NDB-Beitritt des Iran vom Vorstand der Bank offiziell ratifiziert wird, welcher Kapitalbeitrag und welcher Stimmrechtsanteil ihm zugewiesen werden und wie schnell – falls überhaupt – die Bank dazu übergeht, Projektfinanzierungen für iranische Initiativen zu genehmigen.

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: Angesichts der vorsichtigen Haltung der Bank gegenüber bestehenden sanktionierten Mitgliedern erwarten die meisten Beobachter, dass jeder spürbare finanzielle Nutzen für den Iran eher schrittweise als unmittelbar eintreten wird, selbst nachdem die formelle Mitgliedschaft bestätigt wurde.

segments.src: For now, the story is less about an imminent alternative to the dollar and more about how sanctioned states are quietly building the scaffolding for one, one institutional membership at a time.
segments.tr: Im Moment geht es bei der Geschichte weniger um eine unmittelbare Alternative zum Dollar, sondern vielmehr darum, wie sanktionierte Staaten still und leise das Gerüst für eine solche aufbauen, eine institutionelle Mitgliedschaft nach der anderen.

segments.src: The NDB's total lending capacity is a fraction of that of the World Bank, and the bank itself must weigh how closely it wants to associate with a heavily sanctioned member, given its own need to raise capital in international markets where Western investors remain important.
segments.tr: Tổng năng lực cho vay của NDB chỉ bằng một phần nhỏ so với Ngân hàng Thế giới, và chính ngân hàng này phải cân nhắc mức độ gắn kết chặt chẽ với một thành viên đang bị trừng phạt nặng nề, do nhu cầu huy động vốn trên các thị trường quốc tế nơi các nhà đầu tư phương Tây vẫn đóng vai trò quan trọng.

segments.src: Russia's experience — a founding NDB member that has faced difficulty accessing the bank's own resources since 2022 due to compliance concerns among other shareholders — is often cited as a cautionary example.
segments.tr: Trải nghiệm của Nga — một thành viên sáng lập NDB đã gặp khó khăn trong việc tiếp cận các nguồn lực của ngân hàng kể từ năm 2022 do những lo ngại về tuân thủ giữa các cổ đông khác — thường được trích dẫn như một ví dụ cảnh báo.

segments.src: ## A Broader Pattern, Not an Isolated Case
segments.tr: ## Một mô hình rộng lớn hơn, không phải là một trường hợp cá biệt

segments.src: Iran's push fits into a wider trend among sanctioned or sanctions-wary economies to build financial infrastructure that sits outside traditional Western oversight.
segments.tr: Nỗ lực của Iran phù hợp với một xu hướng rộng lớn hơn giữa các nền kinh tế bị trừng phạt hoặc lo ngại về lệnh trừng phạt nhằm xây dựng cơ sở hạ tầng tài chính nằm ngoài sự giám sát truyền thống của phương Tây.

segments.src: Russia, China and several Gulf states have all, in different ways, expanded local-currency trade agreements, alternative payment messaging systems, and non-dollar reserve holdings over the past several years.
segments.tr: Nga, Trung Quốc và một số quốc gia vùng Vịnh đều đã mở rộng các thỏa thuận thương mại bằng nội tệ, các hệ thống nhắn tin thanh toán thay thế và nắm giữ dự trữ không phải bằng đồng đô la theo những cách khác nhau trong vài năm qua.

segments.src: Whether this amounts to a genuine structural shift away from dollar dominance — or simply a set of workarounds for a small number of heavily sanctioned states — remains a subject of debate among economists.
segments.tr: Liệu điều này có dẫn đến một sự thay đổi cấu trúc thực sự thoát khỏi sự thống trị của đồng đô la — hay chỉ đơn giản là một tập hợp các giải pháp thay thế cho một số ít các quốc gia bị trừng phạt nặng nề — vẫn là một chủ đề tranh luận giữa các nhà kinh tế.

segments.src: The dollar still accounts for the large majority of global trade invoicing and central bank reserves, and institutions like the NDB remain small by comparison.
segments.tr: Đồng đô la vẫn chiếm phần lớn trong việc lập hóa đơn thương mại toàn cầu và dự trữ ngân hàng trung ương, và các tổ chức như NDB vẫn còn nhỏ bé khi so sánh.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: The key markers going forward are procedural rather than dramatic: whether Iran's NDB accession is formally ratified by the bank's board, what capital contribution and voting share it is assigned, and how quickly — if at all — the bank moves to approve project financing for Iranian initiatives.
segments.tr: Các dấu hiệu chính trong tương lai mang tính thủ tục hơn là kịch tính: liệu việc gia nhập NDB của Iran có được hội đồng quản trị của ngân hàng phê chuẩn chính thức hay không, mức đóng góp vốn và tỷ lệ bỏ phiếu được phân bổ là bao nhiêu, và ngân hàng sẽ nhanh chóng phê duyệt tài chính dự án cho các sáng kiến của Iran như thế nào — nếu có.

segments.src: Given the bank's cautious posture toward existing sanctioned members, most observers expect any tangible financial benefit to Iran to be gradual rather than immediate, even after formal membership is confirmed.
segments.tr: Với thái độ thận trọng của ngân hàng đối với các thành viên hiện đang bị trừng phạt, hầu hết các nhà quan sát đều kỳ vọng bất kỳ lợi ích tài chính hữu hình nào đối với Iran sẽ diễn ra dần dần thay vì ngay lập tức, ngay cả sau khi tư cách thành viên chính thức được xác nhận.

segments.src: For now, the story is less about an imminent alternative to the dollar and more about how sanctioned states are quietly building the scaffolding for one, one institutional membership at a time.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, câu chuyện không phải là về một sự thay thế sắp xảy ra cho đồng đô la mà là về cách các quốc gia bị trừng phạt đang âm thầm xây dựng giàn giáo cho một sự thay thế như vậy, từng tư cách thành viên tổ chức một.
